scenarios.title: Data events
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Enable registers a ReadingChanged listener and streams pitch/roll/yaw; Disable unregisters and re-enables Enable. With no sensor: status 'No relative inclinometer found', outputs 'No data', Disable disabled.

scenarios.title: Polling
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Get Data polls the sensor once and shows current pitch/roll/yaw. With no sensor: button disabled, outputs 'No data', status 'No relative inclinometer found'.

scoring: round(100 * (pass + 0.5*partial) / features_total). A control present but DEAD relative to a responsive UWP golden is at best partial. Controls inert in BOTH apps (hardware-gated) are parity, not regression.
